nusmp.skill.book_song.description: A grimoire of Song: notes, staff lines, choirs and brass. Every cast puts the Concert Regalia on you for five seconds, the pages call flying notes, a choir of singing spirits and a metronome, and the singing modes of the older pages keep their place. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_bolt: Staccato Bolt: three short note bolts, four ticks apart. Each is a flying note that bursts on the first foe or wall it meets and weakens what it hits. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_cut: Glissando: a staff of five lines drawn straight ahead through every foe on a long line, slowing them. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_field: Choir Field: a field laid at the aimed point for five seconds with three choir spirits standing in it. Every second foes inside are hurt and slowed, and allies are healed a little.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_domain: Grand Concerto: a great burst of music around you that hurts and throws back every foe near and wraps your allies in Absorption.
nusmp.page.book_song.attribute_guard: Aria Armour: Regeneration, a melee bonus and thorns for nine seconds, and the Concert Regalia for as long.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_choir: Choir of Spirits: three singing spirits circle you for twenty seconds. Every second and a half each sings a verse that heals allies near it and hurts the nearest foe.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_metronome: Metronome: a brass metronome planted where you aim for ten seconds. Allies within six blocks of its beat are hastened and foes are slowed.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_harmony: Harmony: up to four allied players within twelve blocks share Resistance, Speed and Regeneration for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_song.song_finale: Grand Finale: everything the song has built is released at once. Every foe within fourteen blocks takes a heavy blow and spiritual damage, allies are healed a quarter of their health (never bosses), and the choir sings its loudest verse.
